description.en: Core CLI commands for session management and configuration
description.zh: 会话管理和配置的核心CLI命令

details.en: Essential commands: `claude` starts sessions, `--help` shows options, `--version` displays version. Control your AI coding experience.
details.zh: 基本命令：`claude`启动会话，`--help`显示选项，`--version`显示版本。控制你的AI编码体验。

description.en: Generate and modify code using plain English descriptions
description.zh: 使用纯英文描述生成和修改代码

details.en: Describe what you want in plain English. Claude creates implementations, handles edge cases, ensures best practices.
details.zh: 用简单的英语描述你的需求。Claude创建实现，处理边界情况，确保最佳实践。

description.en: Read, write, and modify files with AI assistance
description.zh: 在AI辅助下读取、写入和修改文件

details.en: AI reads files before editing, understands existing code, makes precise changes while preserving functionality.
details.zh: AI在编辑前读取文件，理解现有代码，在保持功能的同时进行精确更改。

description.en: Seamless Git operations with intelligent commit messages
description.zh: 无缝Git操作与智能提交消息

details.en: Auto-status checks, feature branches, meaningful commits. Handles merge conflicts and PR workflows.
details.zh: 自动状态检查，功能分支，有意义的提交。处理合并冲突和PR工作流。

description.en: Quick commands with / prefix for common tasks
description.zh: 使用/前缀的快速命令执行常见任务

details.en: Type `/` for commands: `/help`, `/clear`, `/theme`. Fast access to frequent operations.
details.zh: 输入`/`调用命令：`/help`、`/clear`、`/theme`。快速访问常用操作。

description.en: Run long tasks in background with Ctrl+b
description.zh: 使用Ctrl+b在后台运行长时间任务

details.en: Execute time-consuming operations async. Get notified when complete. Continue working meanwhile.
details.zh: 异步执行耗时操作。完成后获得通知。期间继续工作。

description.en: Choose from Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku AI models

details.en: Sonnet for balanced performance, Opus for complex tasks, Haiku for speed. Auto-selection based on task type.
details.zh: Sonnet用于平衡性能，Opus用于复杂任务，Haiku用于速度。基于任务类型自动选择。

description.en: Extend capabilities with Model Context Protocol servers
description.zh: 使用模型上下文协议服务器扩展功能

details.en: Connect to external tools: databases, APIs, file systems. Seamless integration into AI workflow.
details.zh: 连接外部工具：数据库、API、文件系统。无缝集成到AI工作流中。

description.en: Use Claude Code in VS Code, JetBrains, and more

details.en: Native extensions for popular IDEs. Same AI power, familiar workflow. Syntax highlighting, code completion.
details.zh: 流行IDE的原生扩展。相同的AI功能，熟悉的工作流程。语法高亮，代码完成。

description.zh: 理解和优化现有代码库

details.en: AI reads entire codebase, understands patterns, suggests improvements. Finds bugs, refactors safely.
details.zh: AI读取整个代码库，理解模式，建议改进。发现错误，安全重构。

description.en: Generate and run tests with AI assistance
description.zh: 在AI辅助下生成和运行测试

details.en: Create unit tests, integration tests. AI generates test cases, runs them, analyzes coverage.
details.zh: 创建单元测试、集成测试。AI生成测试用例，运行测试，分析覆盖率。

description.en: Auto-generate docs from code and comments
description.zh: 从代码和注释自动生成文档

details.en: AI reads code, creates comprehensive docs. Supports JSDoc, Python docstrings, README files.
details.zh: AI读取代码，创建全面的文档。支持JSDoc、Python文档字符串、README文件。

description.en: Automate tasks with pre and post event hooks
description.zh: 使用前后事件钩子自动化任务

details.en: Run scripts before/after operations: pre-commit, post-save, pre-deploy. Automate workflows.
details.zh: 在操作前后运行脚本：pre-commit、post-save、pre-deploy。自动化工作流。

description.zh: AI在会话之间记住上下文

details.en: Stores project context, preferences, learnings. Resumes where you left off. Gets smarter over time.
details.zh: 存储项目上下文、偏好设置、学习内容。从中断处恢复。越来越聪明。

description.en: Share sessions and collaborate with team members
description.zh: 共享会话并与团队成员协作

details.en: Share Claude conversations, export sessions, collaborative debugging. Team knowledge base.
details.zh: 共享Claude对话，导出会话，协作调试。团队知识库。

description.en: AI-powered security analysis and vulnerability detection
description.zh: AI驱动的安全分析和漏洞检测

details.en: Scans code for security issues, finds vulnerabilities, suggests fixes. OWASP top 10 coverage.
details.zh: 扫描代码安全问题，发现漏洞，建议修复。覆盖OWASP前十。

description.en: Automated deployment workflows with AI assistance
description.zh: AI辅助的自动化部署工作流

details.en: Generate CI/CD pipelines, deploy to multiple platforms. AI handles configuration, optimization.
details.zh: 生成CI/CD管道，部署到多个平台。AI处理配置、优化。
